verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly introduces review and streamlining of all 250 existing questions, including criteria for recommended removals.
The client adds target-specific curation procedures: removal rationales, Google Doc comments, suggesting mode, and creation of a finalized-question manuscript.
The client expands the permitted curation actions and explicitly requires editorial review of proposed additions and removals.
The client explicitly distinguishes the PDF as a reference copy from the Google Doc used for actual suggested edits and comments.
After discussing the submitted Milestone 1 work, the client explicitly terminates the project, removing the remaining curation obligation.
